description: This file contains unit tests for the EventBusTenantManagementAdapter class, verifying its validation logic for tenant payloads, including certificates and tracing configurations.

classes.name: EventBusTenantManagementAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for EventBusTenantManagementAdapter, testing validation of tenant payloads, certificates, and tracing configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the adapter with a mocked TenantManagementService.

methods.name: verifyValidPayload
methods.description: Tests that a valid tenant payload passes validation.

methods.name: verifyValidationFailsForInvalidMinMessageSize
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when the minimum message size is negative.

methods.name: verifyValidationFailsForUnsupportedSamplingMode
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when an unsupported tracing sampling mode is provided.

methods.name: verifyValidTrustedCaSpec
methods.description: Checks that a payload with a valid trusted CA certificate passes validation.

methods.name: verifyInvalidTrustedCaSpec
methods.description: Checks that a payload with a subject DN but missing trusted CA public key fails validation.

methods.name: buildTenantPayload
methods.description: Creates a sample tenant payload JSON object with tracing, enabled status, message size, and adapters.

methods.name: getCaCertificate
methods.description: Generates a self-signed CA certificate for testing purposes.
